verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's first-party docs describe native exact and approximate vector search written in SQL, using ANN indexes in the MergeTree table engine family. Tunable accuracy versus speed parameters are also documented, so no separate vector database is needed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the embedding/vector column storage type, index configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search natively without adding a separate vector database
